title: Evaluation of Clinical Characteristics and Outcome of COVID19 Pneumonia in Assiut University Hospital
brief_summary:
* Evaluation of the clinical presentation of COVID 19 pneumonia.
* Identification the risk factors of severing COVID 19 pneumonia.
* Evaluation of the outcome of the disease.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with COVID 19 PCR positive

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients less than 18 years of age .
study_population: 200 patients diagnosed as COVID19 pneumonia and eligible for search criteria
